title: NOVEMBER
statusNote: Planned and built 2026-11-02 from the production spine and the director's notes: the series card first, the ship's winter preparation in close details, the homecoming, then a wordless winter in which he drinks and she works around him. No music. Sixteen Veo takes, all kept at the first attempt. v1 (45.08 s) was delivered the same day; v2 (42.2 s) applies the director's three notes to v1 (the ship shot ends as the sail comes down, the haul plays reversed, the step over his legs starts mid-step); v3 applies the director's continuity note on v2 (the plug before the stones) and was approved for 4K finishing the same day. The 4K finishing master (the fast native-2x model per segment, blended 50/50 with a Lanczos pass, BT.709 tagged, the approved soundtrack muxed unchanged) was delivered on 2026-11-02 for the director to upload. Published as a YouTube Short on 2026-11-02 (URL user-confirmed). Archived 2026-11-02 under the standard retention: the 4K master and the approved v3 native cut are retained with every take, stem, reference, recipe and record; the v1 and v2 edits, debug copies, assembly segments and 4K finishing candidates were removed (78 files) after the master was re-verified.
